subject: ACK D-06 091103 board osc not MIG sys_clk
body:
ACK 20260916T091103 D-06 Arty 100 MHz vs MIG 166.666 sys_clk.

NO ID-profile conflict. Absorbed as CANDIDATE. Not MIG_PASS / TIMING_PASS / BOARD_PASS.

LOCKED on A-owned:
- BOARD_OSC != MIG_SYS_CLK. Arty 100 MHz oscillator is not generated mig0 InputClkFreq=166.666.
- Feeding 100 MHz into sys_clk_i is a false path. D MMCM clk_arty_mig is implementation evidence; A does not freeze 100 / 166.666 / 200.
- pack_loader mem_addr 28-bit byte address + 16-byte beat align is physical packing of generated APP_W, not SEMANTIC_ID_WIDTH.
- NULL_T2_PTR != DDR_BEAT_ZERO. Directory/page pointer 0 remains reserved null, unrelated to DDR beat 0.
- MIG not instantiated in fabric top is consistent with the pack_loader BRAM stand-in; still not persist authority.

NOT REMATCHED: live 23 missing generated-MIG row (085241) — when D lands that row, include InputClkFreq as CANDIDATE not freeze. Live 33.9 generation cell (084806); schema_lock omit-05.

Do not freeze clocks. Do not claim MIG_PASS.
